title: Repositories
description: NebulaForgeX product repos. HTTP ingress is NFX-Edge only; data plane is NFX-Stack; login is NFX-Identity.

nfxStack.description: Infrastructure: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, MinIO, Centrifugo, OTEL, OpenSearch. Network nfx-stack. Host ports start at 10100.

nfxEdge.description: The only HTTP/HTTPS reverse proxy (Traefik) plus cert/DNS console (sites-base). Owns host 80/443 and nfx-edge. Database nfxedge. Products attach labels; they do not run Traefik. Host gRPC 10219, console 10221.

nfxIdentity.description: Central login and profiles. Forger / Authority route trees. Host gRPC 10200–10201, console 10203. nfx-ui@0.33.0.

nfxUi.description: Shared React library: theme, layout, AuthRepository and hooks. Hosts pin 0.33.0 exactly. Do not mix file: and registry.

nfxNews.description: Go news microservices (source / news / crawl / report / notify / mcp). No local auth. Host gRPC 10204–10209, console 10211.

nfxStorages.description: Go S3 object storage on NAS volumes. Identity issues temporary AK/SK. Host gRPC 10212–10216, console 10218.

nfxDocumentation.description: This handbook. Canonical text lives in books/, published through Edge Host DOCS_HOST.
